title: EntityField
description: A field descriptor inside a SchemaDefinition. Carries the data type, nullability, valid-value constraints, classification tags, and glossary term links.

name.description: Field name or JSONPath within the schema (e.g. "patient.dateOfBirth").

dataType.description: LEGACY. The logical data type as a bare string (e.g. "string", "integer", "date"), constrained by nothing and documented only by the examples in this sentence. It cannot carry an element type, so an array is indistinguishable from a scalar, and no consumer can check it. Retained because existing fields carry it; prefer `valueType`, which composes and is checkable.

valueType.description: Structural type for this field. When present it is authoritative, and `dataType`, if also present, must agree with its head constructor.

nullable.description: LEGACY. Optionality as a sibling boolean, which can contradict the type beside it. Under `valueType`, absence is expressed by the `optional` wrapper instead, so there is one statement rather than two that can disagree.

validValues.description: Optional valid-value constraint: enumeration, range, or regex.

tags.description: Classification tags applied to this field (e.g. PII tags).

glossaryTerms.description: URNs of GlossaryTerms that this field represents. Pattern: urn:srcos:glossary:<id>

dataClassRef.description: Optional binding to the OntoDQ DataClass this field is an instance of. When set, the field's validValues must conform to the DataClass domain (validator).
